segments.ja532:1.1: “Devatā nusi gandhabbo, adu [ādu (sī. syā.)] sakko purindado;
segments.ja532:1.3: Manussabhūto iddhimā, kathaṃ jānemu taṃ mayaṃ”.
segments.ja532:2.1: “Nāpi devo na gandhabbo, nāpi sakko purindado;
segments.ja532:4.3: Tato amittamajjhesu [amittamajjhe ca (sī.)], saratāṇaṃ bhavaṃ akā.
segments.ja532:5.1: “Tato phītāni raṭṭhāni, vasino te bhavaṃ akā;
segments.ja532:5.3: Tato ekasataṃ khatye, anuyante [anuyutte (pī.)] bhavaṃ akā.
segments.ja532:6.1: “Patītāssu mayaṃ bhoto, vada taṃ [vara taṃ (sī. syā. pī.)] bhañja [bhañña (sī. pī.), bhuñja (syā. ka.)] micchasi;
segments.ja532:7.1: “Atha vaṅge [atha vā saṅge (sī. pī.)] vā magadhe, mayaṃ bhoto dadāmase;
segments.ja532:7.3: Atha vā assakāvantī [assakāvantiṃ (sī. syā. pī.)], sumanā damma te mayaṃ.
segments.ja532:8.3: Sace te attho rajjena, anusāsa yadicchasi”.
segments.ja532:9.1: “Na me atthopi rajjena, nagarena dhanena vā;
segments.ja532:9.3: Athopi janapadena, attho mayhaṃ na vijjati.
segments.ja532:10.3: Pitā mayhaṃ janettī ca, ubho sammanti assame.
segments.ja532:11.3: Bhavantaṃ ajjhāvaraṃ katvā, soṇaṃ [sonaṃ (pī.)] yācemu saṃvaraṃ”.
segments.ja532:12.1: “Karomi te taṃ vacanaṃ, yaṃ maṃ bhaṇasi brāhmaṇa;
segments.ja532:12.3: Etañca kho no akkhāhi, kīvanto hontu yācakā”.
segments.ja532:13.3: Ime ca khattiyā sabbe, abhijātā yasassino;
segments.ja532:13.5: Bhavañca rājā manojo, alaṃ hessanti yācakā”.
segments.ja532:14.1: “Hatthī asse ca yojentu, rathaṃ sannayha sārathi [naṃ rathi (pī.)];
segments.ja532:14.3: Ābandhanāni gaṇhātha, pādāsussārayaddhaje [pādesussārayaṃ dhaje (sī.), pādāsussārayaṃ dhaje (pī.)];
segments.ja532:14.5: Assamaṃ taṃ gamissāmi, yattha sammati kosiyo”.
segments.ja532:15.3: Agamā assamaṃ rammaṃ, yattha sammati kosiyo”.
segments.ja532:16.3: Aṃsaṃ asamphusaṃ eti, udahārāya [udahārassa (sī. syā. pī.)] gacchato”.
segments.ja532:19.3: Maggaṃ no soṇa akkhāhi, yena gacchemu [gacchāma (sī.)] assamaṃ”.
segments.ja532:26.1: “Kassa bherī mudiṅgā ca [mutiṅgā ca (pī.)], saṅkhā paṇavadindimā [deṇḍimā (sī. pī.)];
segments.ja532:27.3: Yuvā kalāpasannaddho, ko eti siriyā jalaṃ.
segments.ja532:28.3: Mukhañca rucirā bhāti, ko eti siriyā jalaṃ.
segments.ja532:31.3: Samantā parikirenti [parikiranti (sī. syā. pī.)], ko eti siriyā jalaṃ.
segments.ja532:33.1: “Hatthi assaratha patti [hatthī assā rathā pattī (sī.)], senā ca caturaṅginī;
segments.ja532:33.3: Samantānupariyanti [samantā anupariyāti (pī.)], ko eti siriyā jalaṃ.
segments.ja532:38.1: “Kacci nu bhoto kusalaṃ, kacci bhoto anāmayaṃ;
segments.ja532:38.3: Kacci uñchena yāpetha, kacci mūlaphalā bahū.
segments.ja532:39.1: “Kacci ḍaṃsā makasā ca, appameva sarīsapā [siriṃsapā (sī. syā. pī.)];
segments.ja532:39.3: Vane vāḷamigākiṇṇe, kacci hiṃsā na vijjati”.
segments.ja532:40.3: Atho uñchena yāpema, atho mūlaphalā bahū.
segments.ja532:41.1: “Atho ḍaṃsā makasā ca [ḍaṃsā ca makasā (sī.), ḍaṃsā ca makasā ca (pī.)], appameva sarīsapā [siriṃsapā (sī. syā. pī.)];
segments.ja532:41.3: Vane vāḷamigākiṇṇe, hiṃsā mayhaṃ [a mhaṃ (sī. pī.)] na vijjati.
segments.ja532:44.3: Phalāni khuddakappāni, bhuñja rāja varaṃ varaṃ.
segments.ja532:45.3: Tato piva mahārāja, sace tvaṃ abhikaṅkhasi”.
segments.ja532:46.3: Nandassāpi nisāmetha, vacanaṃ so [yaṃ (sī.), yaṃ so (pī.)] pavakkhati.
segments.ja532:47.3: Suṇātu [suṇātu me (sī. syā.)] bhavaṃ vacanaṃ, nandassa parisāya ca”.
segments.ja532:48.3: Ime ca khattiyā sabbe, abhijātā yasassino;
segments.ja532:48.5: Bhavañca rājā manojo, anumaññantu me vaco.
segments.ja532:49.1: “Ye ca santi [ye vasanti (sī.), ye hi santi (pī.)] samītāro, yakkhāni idha massame;
segments.ja532:50.3: So tyāhaṃ dakkhiṇā bāhu, tava kosiya sammato.
segments.ja532:51.3: Vīra puññamidaṃ ṭhānaṃ, mā maṃ kosiya vāraya.
segments.ja532:53.3: Maggo saggassa lokassa, yathā jānāsi tvaṃ ise.
segments.ja532:54.3: Taṃ maṃ puññā nivāreti, ariyamaggāvaro naro”.
segments.ja532:55.5: Adhammacārī jeṭṭhesu [yo jeṭṭho (sī.)], nirayaṃ sopapajjati [so upapajjati (sī. syā. pī.)].
segments.ja532:56.3: Cārittena ca sampannā, na te gacchanti duggatiṃ.
segments.ja532:57.3: Sabbe jeṭṭhassa te bhārā, evaṃ jānāhi bhāradha [bhāratha (syā.)].
segments.ja532:59.1: “Adhigamā [adhigatamhā (sī.), adhigamhā (syā.), adhigatamha (pī.)] tame ñāṇaṃ, jālaṃva jātavedato;
segments.ja532:59.3: Evameva no bhavaṃ dhammaṃ, kosiyo pavidaṃsayi.
segments.ja532:60.5: Evameva no bhavaṃ dhammaṃ, kosiyo pavidaṃsayi”.
segments.ja532:61.3: Tava paddhacaro [tava paṭṭhacaro (syā.), tava baddhañcaro (pī.), tavupaṭṭhacaro (ka.)] hessaṃ, vuṭṭhito paricārako”.
segments.ja532:62.3: Ariyo ariyasamācāro, bāḷhaṃ tvaṃ mama ruccasi.
segments.ja532:63.3: Nāyaṃ bhāro bhāramato [bhāramatto (sī. syā.)], ahu mayhaṃ kudācanaṃ.
segments.ja532:65.3: Nandaṃ vo varatha eko [nandaṃ vadatha eke (pī.)], kaṃ nando upatiṭṭhatu”.
segments.ja532:66.1: “Tayā tāta anuññātā, soṇa taṃ nissitā mayaṃ;
segments.ja532:67.3: Cirassaṃ nandaṃ disvāna, hadayaṃ me pavedhati.
segments.ja532:68.1: “Yadā suttāpi supine [suppante (syā. pī.)], nandaṃ passāmi āgataṃ;
segments.ja532:68.3: Udaggā sumanā homi, nando no āgato ayaṃ.
segments.ja532:70.3: Bhattucca [bhattuñca (ka.)] mayhañca piyo, nando no pāvisī gharaṃ.
segments.ja532:71.1: “Pitupi nando suppiyo, yaṃ nando nappavase [pāvisī (pī.)] gharā [gharaṃ (syā. pī. ka.)];
segments.ja532:71.3: Labhatū tāta nando taṃ, maṃ nando upatiṭṭhatu”.
segments.ja532:72.1: “Anukampikā patiṭṭhā ca, pubbe rasadadī ca no;
segments.ja532:72.3: Maggo saggassa lokassa, mātā taṃ varate ise.
segments.ja532:73.3: Maggo saggassa lokassa, mātā taṃ varate ise”.
segments.ja532:75.1: “Tassā utumhi nhātāya [utusinātāya (pī.)], hoti gabbhassa vokkamo [gabbhassa’ vakkamo (sī. syā. pī.)];
segments.ja532:75.3: Tena dohaḷinī hoti, suhadā tena vuccati.
segments.ja532:76.3: Tena sā janayantīti, janetti [janettī (sī. syā. pī.)] tena vuccati.
segments.ja532:77.3: Rodantaṃ puttaṃ [eva (pī.)] toseti, tosentī tena vuccati.
segments.ja532:79.3: Ubhayampetassa gopeti, api puttassa no siyā.
segments.ja532:80.1: “Evaṃ putta aduṃ putta, iti mātā vihaññati;
segments.ja532:80.5: Sāyaṃ puttaṃ anāyantaṃ, iti mātā vihaññati.
segments.ja532:83.3: Mātaraṃ aparicaritvāna, kicchaṃ vā so nigacchati.
segments.ja532:84.3: Pitaraṃ aparicaritvāna, kicchaṃ vā so nigacchati.
segments.ja532:87.1: “Dānañca peyyavajjañca [piyavācā ca (sī. syā. ka.)], atthacariyā ca yā idha;
segments.ja532:87.3: Samānattatā [samānattā (pī.)] ca dhammesu, tattha tattha yathārahaṃ;
segments.ja532:87.5: Ete kho saṅgahā loke, rathassāṇīva yāyato.
segments.ja532:88.1: Ete ca saṅgahā nāssu, na mātā puttakāraṇā;
segments.ja532:88.3: Labhetha mānaṃ pūjaṃ vā [pūjañca (pī.)], pitā vā puttakāraṇā.
segments.ja532:89.1: “Yasmā ca saṅgahā [saṅgahe (dī. ni.3.273; a. ni.4.32) tadaṭṭhakathāyo oloketabbā] ete, sammapekkhanti [samavekkhanti (sī. syā. pī.) a. ni.4.32] paṇḍitā;
segments.ja532:89.3: Tasmā mahattaṃ papponti, pāsaṃsā ca bhavanti te.
segments.ja532:91.1: “Tasmā hi ne namasseyya, sakkareyya ca paṇḍito;
segments.ja532:91.3: Annena atho [matho (pī.), atha (a. ni.4.63; itivu.106)] pānena, vatthena sayanena ca;
segments.ja532:91.5: Ucchādanena nhāpanena [nahāpanena (sī. pī.)], pādānaṃ dhovanena ca.
segments.ja532:92.3: Idheva naṃ pasaṃsanti, pecca sagge pamodatī”ti.
segments.ja532:96.3: Atha soṇasunandavaro ca puna, abhivāsitasattatimamhi suteti.
